prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis — the right agency depends on your organization’s goals, budget, services needed (branding, digital, SEO, paid media, patient acquisition, physician referral programs, B2B sales, medical devices, etc.), compliance needs, and culture fit.

To help you find the best match, tell me a bit about your needs (I can then shortlist agencies and/or draft an RFP). Meanwhile, here’s a practical way to evaluate and choose an agency plus next steps I can take for you.

Key questions for you
- What type of healthcare organization are you? (hospital system, clinic, specialty practice, medical device, pharma, behavioral health, payer, etc.)
- Primary goals: brand awareness, patient acquisition, referral growth, clinician recruitment, product launches, lead generation, PR, or other?
- Services you need: strategy/branding, web design, SEO, content, paid media, social, analytics, CRM/marketing automation, creative/production?
- Annual marketing budget or project budget range?
- Timeline and any regulatory constraints (HIPAA, FDA, etc.)?
- Preference for local agency vs. national firm with St. Louis presence?

How to identify the best-fit agency
- Relevant healthcare experience: case studies showing measurable outcomes for similar organizations (patient acquisition cost, lead quality, conversions).
- Regulatory/compliance expertise: HIPAA, patient privacy, and (if applicable) FDA or state rules.
- Data and measurement: ability to integrate with EHR/CRM, track attribution, report ROI.
- Creative + clinical credibility: they should speak both to consumers and clinicians appropriately.
- References and local relationships: references from other St. Louis-area healthcare clients, plus relationships with local media/hospital networks.
- Team and capacity: senior team involvement, not just account execs; capabilities for your scale.
- Technology stack: experience with your CMS, CRM, ad platforms, and analytics tools.
- Transparency and processes: clear onboarding, timelines, reporting cadence, and SLAs.

Questions to ask prospective agencies
- Have you worked with organizations like ours? Can you share outcomes and metrics?
- How do you approach HIPAA-compliant marketing and data handling?
- How will you measure success for our goals? What KPIs do you propose?
- What tools/platforms will you use and who owns creative/assets?
- Can you provide references and a recent case study?
- What is your pricing model and typical contract length?
- Who will be our day-to-day contacts and what senior resources will be involved?

Selection process and timeline
- Shortlist 3–5 agencies based on experience and initial conversations.
- Ask for a brief proposal (or scoped pilot project) focusing on 30/90/180-day goals.
- Check references and sample reporting.
- Negotiate scope, KPIs, and a trial or pilot to validate performance before long-term commitment.

If you want, I can:
- Build a tailored RFP or pilot brief.
- Research and shortlist 4–6 St. Louis agencies with proven healthcare work (I’ll need your answers to the questions above).
- Draft the interview questions and scoring rubric for evaluating proposals.

Which of the above would you like me to do next?
